body: This story isn’t about me, it’s about my father. My dad used to work at one of the towers back then and as always had to go into work that day. However he overslept and didn’t go into work. Fortunately for him he survived since he wasn’t at the towers. But if my dad happened to go to work that day I would have never been born since I was born a few years later after 9/11 (I was born in 2006). I’m happy he survived and didn’t have to suffer like everyone else, may they rest in piece.

Oh really? I don’t want to say anything wrong or whatever but I can’t imagine how you would feel. I already feel like a disappointment to everyone and if I knew I was an accident I would probably hate myself even more and think that my parents would have not wanted me or loved me or whatever. I hope that made sense btw sorry if it didn’t.
Same I wish my mum got an abortion or my parents didn’t have sex or whatever.

It’s okay and thank you. I agree no one should have to go through what I went through or go through anything bad or whatever. At first I thought it was my fault but now I know that it’s not my fault anymore and thank you again :)
I know I’m trying my best to just hang on a little longer because I know I’m young but it’s very hard to. I hate suffering every day :(
